blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–National University captured the inaugural UAAP men’s badminton team title under the new format, beating Ateneo, 3-1, in Wednesday’s Season 89 final at Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City. The Bulldogs head into the individual competitions with 15 points, ahead of Ateneo’s 12, and will look to sustain their momentum behind top-ranked shuttler Clarence Villaflor.
